config: onnxruntime quantize_dynamic, QuantType.QInt8, MatMul only, per-tensor, quant_pre_process skip_symbolic_shape=True
verdict: REJECTED. Faster but flips 4 of 24 decisions; not shippable for a calibrated classifier. The Laya/ModernBERT family has attention-sink outliers, consistent with the llama.cpp Laya reviewer's note that Q8_0 changed ~90/2000 Julia-1 decisions. A safe quantizer would need per-channel/per-block protection or keeping sensitive layers in F16, then re-proving parity.
